original_test_intent: Measure numerically valid CPU HPL performance and compare it with a configuration-matched Intel or AMD reference.

original_procedure_criteria.procedure: Source gives AMD hpl.tar.bz2 installation, versioned Ubuntu 20.04/GCC9 scripts, generated HPL files and `run_hpl_ccx.sh`.
original_procedure_criteria.criteria: Result matches the applicable Intel/AMD specification.

historical_reviews.gpt_v2: Required package/input and preserved performance provenance.
historical_reviews.v3: SOURCE_CONFLICT; prohibited applying AMD CCX scripts to Intel or unsupported AMD generations.

v3_1_conclusion.manual_test_activity: Engineer selects CPU vendor/SKU, qualified HPL distribution/profile and comparable reference; approved execution is automatable.
required_user_inputs: Run/repetition rule and meaning of 360 minutes

master_vs_project_parameters.master_default: Preserve AMD package/script details and 60/360-minute planning values as source provenance.
master_vs_project_parameters.project_inputs: Vendor-specific package, topology profile, repetitions, baseline and limits.
master_vs_project_parameters.coverage_difference: An AMD or Intel project path completes only its approved platform scope; it does not rewrite the Common source conflict.

original_method: Retain the versioned AMD install/run procedure for compatible AMD platforms only.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Prefer the project-qualified vendor HPL package/profile or existing performance harness; preserve HPL.dat, placement and residual validation.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Exact package/CPU/OS/compiler/BLAS/MPI compatibility must be documented.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Applicable Intel/AMD package documentation plus HPL numerical validation documentation.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original: Adds a vendor gate and reproducible profile instead of treating AMD CCX scripts as universal.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: No cross-vendor substitution; project-specific execution scope is explicit.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Root/network installer, sustained load and non-comparable tuning can invalidate or endanger the run.

safety_boundaries: No cross-vendor scripts or silent topology tuning.
Preserve logs and stop at approved thermal/power/error limits.
expected_evidence: Full Gflop/s and residual output per run
no_automatic_retry: Numerical failure, throttle or invalid profile is retained; no retuning/rerun without approval.
engineer_owned_verdict: Agent reports numerical validity and comparison; engineer decides comparability and outcome.
review_improvement: V3.1 retains the genuine source conflict while allowing a project engineer to select a valid current vendor path without pretending the Master Library was permanently repaired.
